title: A conversation email's footer links back to where the conversation started

source.ref: owner 2026-10-20 in the project thread: the link back should go to the feature the message came from; a direct message goes to the profile, a Circle or Journey thread goes there

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: the footer 'Back to' link always pointed at the Space page, so a reply that started in a Circle, Event or Journey sent the reader somewhere unrelated. THE FIX: resolveEmailOrigin (lib/comms/email-brand.ts) reads the thread's scope and returns the Circle, Event or Journey page; an unscoped message returns the sender's profile; anything else, or a read fault, returns null and the footer keeps the Space link. The compose, batch flush and inbound bridge paths pass it to renderReplyEmail and renderCoalescedEmail.

verify.note: PASS 2026-10-20: the resolver exists and the footer prefers the origin; vitest lib/comms green.
